# Party Rats

> Party Rats is a creative collective that designs custom parties, celebrations and experiences from the idea up. Ideas first. Everything else follows.

Party Rats brings together designers, makers, cooks, musicians and problem-solvers around each idea, then obsesses over the details until it becomes something worth showing up for. It takes on the unexpected projects, the ones that make guests say "I have absolutely no idea how they pulled this off."

## What Party Rats does

- Creative Concepts: original party and event ideas built around the story or feeling behind the celebration
- Food + Drink
- Design + Décor
- Music + Entertainment
- Custom Merch

## Who it's for

People planning a celebration who want something original and personal, not a checklist party.

## How to get in touch

Share what you're celebrating, what you're imagining and what feels impossible at https://thepartyrats.com/#inquire
